$comment: Contract Verification Results SEP (draft) — one page of a bulk-load stream. Closed for a producer; a consumer validates with additionalProperties relaxed, so a higher MINOR stays readable.
title: Contract Verification Bulk-Load Page (Results SEP 1.0)
description: The body of GET /v1/wasms on a verifier: records reference this verifier's own documents. The envelope is shared and the record shape belongs to the role serving the stream — the Contract Verification Aggregation SEP defines an aggregator's records over the same schema value, in stellar-verification-page-aggregated-1.0.schema.json.

schema.description: The document type. Every Results SEP document names its type here beside its version.

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR of this envelope, and of the envelope only. A record is a pointer at a document, not the document, so nothing here restates a status object's version.

order.description: The direction this page pages in, echoed back so a consumer never has to remember what it asked for.

cursor.description: The cursor for the next page, {timestamp}-{wasm_hash}; null at the end of the stream. A record may legitimately reappear on a later page — a verifier's clock is publication update time, which a backfill advances — so consumers upsert by wasm_hash rather than treating re-delivery as duplication.

records.description: This page's records, in `order`. Empty is a valid page and means the stream has caught up, not that the verifier has nothing.

reference_record.description: A per-verifier page's record: a pointer, not a result. The consumer fetches wasms/{wasm_hash}.json for the document itself — which keeps a page small enough that enumeration is cheap and the result is read at its source.

updated_at.description: This verifier's publication update time for that hash — the clock this stream is ordered by.
